macro_brief: MACRO WEATHER (D-4, informs posture, gates nothing) — Regime GREEN, VIX 17.5, breadth positive, 12 trend-days. CROSS-ASSET READ: USD (UUP) trending DOWN, below 20/50MA — soft dollar is a tailwind for risk, commodities, EM and global/semis. Bonds (TLT) BID, reclaimed 50MA, yields easing — supportive for duration and long-duration growth (software, semis, large-cap tech multiples). Credit (HYG firm vs TLT) tightening — spreads tight, risk appetite healthy, a clean risk-on confirmation. Breadth (SPY leads IWM) — large-cap leadership, breadth narrowing slightly, so favor genuine large-cap leaders over small-cap/high-beta chasers. RISK-ON/OFF: risk-ON tape, all four intermarket legs aligned constructively. THE REGIME CAVEAT, PLAINLY: Hurst 0.502 = RANDOM WALK. There is NO trend-persistence edge right now — momentum has no statistical follow-through, and chasing extended high-beta names is uncompensated (MEAN_REVERT implication: today's leader is not tomorrow's edge). Bonds/currencies/credit say risk-on; the Hurst says do not press momentum hard. SECTOR HEADWINDS/TAILWINDS for the set: TAILWINDS — Information Technology (bond-bid growth + AI capex), Semis/Global (soft-dollar direct beneficiary), Financials (tight credit + risk appetite healthy), Communication Services (large-cap leadership). EM/LatAm fintech gets a direct soft-dollar tailwind. HEADWINDS — Solar/Clean Energy, Office REITs, Residential REITs (macro laggards, avoid); high-beta software/AI-infra names carry regime risk given the random walk. SIZING TONE: NORMAL, not aggressive. GREEN tape + soft dollar + bond bid earn a constructive posture, but the Hurst random walk plus narrowing breadth cap aggression — concentrate in low-to-moderate-beta quality leaders, keep aggression reserved for a persistence regime we do not have. Aggression is for tailwinds with an edge; today has the tailwind but not the edge.
